description: Department of Digital Infrastruture  & Information Technology -  The Electronic Transaction (Sri Lanka Identification Number) Regulation
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Electronic Transactions Act, No. 19 of 2006, establishing the Sri Lanka Identification Number (SLIN) system and mandating its use for citizen-based transactions. The content focuses on creating new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "new laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements."
